selection_rule: Sample 18 evenly spaced canvas fractions across the Yale IIIF manifest after excluding only non-image/unfetchable canvases. Do not use EVA, Currier, section labels, glyph identities, prior similarity judgments, or hand labels to choose pages. The same image-derived word-like crop detector used on ordinary-script controls is applied to Voynich. Hand/section labels may be joined only after feature extraction for secondary stratified analysis.
primary_aggregate: single-manuscript robust centroid over all accepted crops; page-level blocks retained for sensitivity analysis only
